jobs.description:
Are you practical, enjoy physical work and thrive in a fast-paced environment? We are currently looking for 2 tyre fitters for the upcoming tyre-changing season in Skejby.

About the job

As a tyre fitter, your main responsibility will be to help our customers safely change from summer to winter tyres. The work takes place in a professional workshop, where the season can be very busy and good teamwork is essential.

Your duties will include:

• 
Removing and fitting wheels and tyres

• 
Changing between summer and winter wheels

• 
Checking tyre pressure and the general condition of the tyres

• 
Moving and handling wheels and tyres

• 
Preparing and keeping the work area clean and tidy

• 
Where required, washing and registering customers’ wheels

We expect you to

• 
Be reliable, punctual and hardworking

• 
Be able to work efficiently while maintaining a high standard of quality

• 
Be physically fit, as the work involves lifting

• 
Be able to work both independently and as part of a team

• 
Be flexible regarding working hours during the busy season

• 
Speak and understand Danish or English

Previous experience as a tyre fitter, mechanic or in similar work is an advantage, but not necessarily a requirement. You will receive instruction and training in the relevant tasks.

We offer

• 
Seasonal work during a busy and attractive period

• 
Good working conditions

• 
Thorough introduction to the job and tasks

• 
A good and friendly working environment

• 
Competitive pay in accordance with the applicable 3F collective agreement

• 
Full-time work as a starting point, with the possibility of additional working hours during the peak season

Employment period

The position is a temporary seasonal role in connection with the autumn tyre-changing season. The exact employment period and working hours will be agreed individually.

Interested?

Please send your application or a short description of yourself and your experience as soon as possible.

Email: humanizer@pshr.dk
Phone: +45 53 53 11 99

Apply directly online:

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, and we will hire candidates as soon as we find the right people.

CE-chauffør søges – nat-dag tur Jylland–Sjælland

Fast ugentlig tur:

Vi søger en erfaren CE-chauffør til fast kørsel mellem Skanderborg og Sjælland – med start søndag nat/mandag og slut fredag.

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

• 
Start Skanderborg ca. kl. 23.00

• 
2–3 stop på Sjælland

• 
Retur med anden trailer

• 
Trailerbytte i Taulov eller Skanderborg – så slut

• 
Kørsel fra søndag nat/mandag til fredag

• 
Ca. 11-12 timers arbejde pr. dag

Vi forventer

• 
CE-kørekort

• 
Erfaring med trailerkørsel

• 
Ansvarlig, stabil og selvstændig

• 
Trives med nat-start og faste ruter

Vi tilbyder

• 
Forudsigelig ugerute

• 
Selvstændigt arbejde med tillid

• 
Løn efter ATL-overenskomst

• 
Ordentlighed og faste rammer

Send ansøgning til job@24group.dk
eller ring til os på 28199818 for mere info.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

English version:

CE Driver Wanted – Night-Day Route Jutland–Zealand

Fixed weekly route. Night start

We are looking for an experienced CE driver for a fixed run between Skanderborg and Zealand – starting Sunday night/Monday and ending Friday.

What does the job involve?

• 
Start in Skanderborg at approx. 23:00

• 
2–3 stops on Zealand

• 
Return with a different trailer

• 
Trailer swap in Taulov or Skanderborg – then end of shift

• 
Driving from Sunday night/Monday through Friday

• 
Approx. 11-12 hours of work per day

We expect you to:

• 
Hold a valid CE license

• 
Have experience with truck + trailer

• 
Be responsible, stable, and self-sufficient

• 
Thrive with night starts and fixed routes

We offer:

• 
Predictable weekly route

• 
Independent work with trust

• 
Pay according to the ATL collective agreement

• 
Honesty, structure, and clear frameworks

Send your application to job@24group.dk
or call us at 28199818 for more information.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Midwife with International Experience Wanted for the Labour Ward at Aalborg University Hospital
jobs.description:
Become Part of a Unique Community – Midwife with International Experience Wanted for the Labour Ward at Aalborg University Hospital
Do you dream of working in a place where professional excellence, compassion, and development go hand in hand? 
Where you are surrounded every day by dedicated colleagues, and where your skills and experience are recognised, utilised, and appreciated?
If so, this is your opportunity to join our fantastic maternity team at Aalborg University Hospital.

We are seeking a midwife with international experience and knowledge of different childbirth cultures for a permanent position, starting on 1 September 2026 or as soon as possible. We wish to expand our work on childbirth culture and cultural understanding and are therefore looking for a midwife who can contribute to this development. The position is not a development role, but a standard clinical midwife position on the labour ward with a special professional profile.

We expect you to have experience working as a midwife in a non-European country and to be fluent in a widely spoken world language other than English. You must have completed the Danish adaptation and evaluation employment programme and hold Danish authorisation as a midwife.

Why Choose Us?
At Aalborg University Hospital, you will find more than just a job—you will become part of a strong, supportive, and professionally inspiring community.
We are the largest maternity unit in the North Denmark Region. As a highly specialised department, we provide care for approximately 3,300 pregnant women, women in labour, postpartum women, and their families each year. Here, you will have the opportunity to apply your professional expertise in a dynamic environment with varied responsibilities and room for both specialisation and professional development.

In addition, we offer:

• A clinical supervising midwife on every shift as a dedicated professional mentor
• A personal coordinator during your onboarding period
• A buddy system on every shift
• Opportunities for professional courses, supervision, and targeted competency development
• Teams and professional communities that hold regular group meetings with both professional and social content
You will become part of a large and engaged professional community consisting of approximately 150 skilled colleagues—midwives, nurses, healthcare assistants, doctors, and administrative staff—all dedicated to creating safe, coordinated, and professional maternity care pathways.

Opportunities with Us
We understand that a long working life includes changing needs and interests. Therefore, we place great emphasis on flexibility and the opportunity to combine different functions according to your preferences.
This means you may combine work in areas such as:

• Labour Ward and Midwifery Antenatal Clinic
• Labour Ward and Maternity Assessment Unit
• Labour Ward and Postnatal Ward
The majority of our midwives work in combined positions like these, creating professional variety, development opportunities, and job satisfaction.
We highly prioritise education and professional growth, and as a midwife with us, you will be part of a workplace where learning and development are natural parts of everyday practice.

Who Are You?
You are a qualified midwife with substantial professional experience from another country and exposure to a different childbirth culture.
You thrive in a professionally strong environment where teamwork, safety, and professionalism are central values.
You are passionate about working in the birthing suite. You enjoy building new relationships and work confidently both in complex obstetric cases and in births where the most important task is simply “being there” for the woman and her family.
You are able to identify the differences between childbirth cultures and contribute valuable insights and reflections to the daily professional discussions on the labour ward.

In addition, we expect that you are fluent in a widely spoken world language other than English. You must have completed the Danish adaptation and evaluation employment programme and hold Danish authorisation as a midwife.

Most importantly, you:

• Want to become part of a committed and caring team
• Contribute positively to a supportive and developmental work environment
• Are passionate about creating safe and coherent childbirth experiences
Our Values – Your Foundation
Our work is based on the North Denmark Region’s core values: Involvement, Trust, Decency, and Professionalism (I-TOP).
This means that we meet women, families, and relatives with empathy and respect—and we treat each other in the same way.

We Offer You

• A workplace characterised by high professional standards, warmth, and humour
• Strong interdisciplinary collaboration where everyone contributes
• A quality standard that ensures one midwife for every woman in labour
• A work environment where psychological and physical well-being are prioritised
• Supervision by trained supervisors in structured group programmes
• A unique collaboration between Health and Safety Representatives, Union Representatives, and Management, based on openness, respect, and trust
• A department where ideas are encouraged and where your voice matters
• A workplace that values your experience and is genuinely curious about your professional background
And last—but certainly not least:
The best colleagues in the world and a workplace you look forward to coming to every day.

Salary and Employment Conditions
Salary and employment terms according to the current collective agreement for non-managing midwives, etc., concluded with the Danish Midwives' Association.

Further Information
For questions about the position, please contact:
Arianne Brandborg Nørhave
Acting Deputy Head Midwife and Manager of the Labour Ward
Phone: +45 20 73 07 50
Email: a.noerhave@rn.dk

Recruitment Process
Application deadline: 20th of september 2026
Please submit your application, CV, and any other relevant documents electronically to this e-mail: m.cederstroem@rn.dk

Interviews: Expected to take place shortly after the application deadline.

Starting date: 1th of October 2026 or earlier by agreement.

jobs.occupation: Paving Worker / Landscaping Construction Worker – Practical Skills
jobs.description:
Work location: Denmark
Working hours: 37 hours per week
Employment type: Full-time, permanent position
Salary: After qualificatons
Start date: By agreement

About the position

We are looking for practical and reliable employees to carry out paving and landscaping construction work in Denmark.

The position is suitable for candidates who have good practical skills, an aptitude for manual work and an interest in construction and outdoor work.

A formal vocational qualification as a paving worker or landscaper is not required.

Instead, we value practical experience, a good understanding of manual work, accuracy, reliability and the ability to learn new working methods.

Main duties

The work will primarily include:

• 
Paving and surfacing work

• 
Laying paving stones, concrete slabs, cobblestones, kerbstones and other paving materials

• 
Measuring, setting out and preparing work areas

• 
Excavation and preparation of ground and sub-base

• 
Levelling and compacting sub-base and sand

• 
Cutting and adapting paving materials

• 
Establishing and adjusting edges, levels and gradients

• 
Minor landscaping and groundworks

• 
Using hand tools and small construction machinery

• 
General maintenance and cleaning of the work area

• 
Following applicable health, safety and environmental regulations

The exact tasks may vary depending on the project and the employee's practical experience.

We are looking for someone who

• 
Has a natural aptitude for practical and manual work

• 
Is comfortable with physically demanding work

• 
Works accurately and takes pride in the quality of their work

• 
Can work independently based on instructions

• 
Works well as part of a team

• 
Is reliable, punctual and responsible

• 
Is motivated to learn and develop practical skills

• 
Preferably has previous experience in paving, landscaping, construction, groundworks, installation, renovation or other practical work

A formal vocational qualification is not required.

Relevant practical experience from construction, civil works, groundworks, installation, renovation, agriculture or other practical occupations is considered an advantage.

Language requirements

English is an advantage.

Danish is not required at the time of employment. However, the employee must be able to understand relevant work instructions and health and safety instructions sufficiently to perform the work safely.

Salary and employment conditions

The fixed and guaranteed salary is:

DKK 37,500 gross per month for 37 hours of work per week.

In addition, the employer provides an occupational pension in accordance with the applicable employment terms.

The fixed cash salary corresponds to your qualifications

The salary is fixed and guaranteed and is not dependent on bonuses, commissions or overtime.

Employment conditions, including working hours, pension, holiday entitlement, overtime and notice periods, will be specified in the employment contract and will comply with applicable Danish legislation and customary Danish employment conditions for the position.

Occupation / DISCO-08

DISCO-08: 711220 – Paving Work

The position specifically involves paving and surfacing work, including the preparation, installation and finishing of paved surfaces.

What we offer

• 
Permanent full-time employment in Denmark

• 
37-hour working week

• 
Fixed salary matched to your qualifications

• 
Training and introduction to the company's working methods

• 
Varied projects within paving and landscaping construction

• 
A professional working environment

• 
Opportunity to develop practical and manual skills

How to apply

Please send your CV and a short description of your previous work experience.

You do not need to have a formal vocational qualification.

Instead, please describe the practical work you have previously performed, the tools or machinery you have experience using, and the types of tasks you are accustomed to carrying out.

Candidates will be assessed based on their practical experience, aptitude for manual work, motivation, reliability and ability to learn.

This is a genuine full-time position in Denmark and the vacancy will be advertised through Jobnet and EURES.

DAMRC is a research and development centre for advanced manufacturing. We are internationally recognised for our work in metal processing, and our job is to turn new technology into something Danish manufacturers can use on the shop floor.

You will work both in our own R&D centre in Herning, where trials can be run without stopping a production line, and out at the companies themselves, where the solution has to survive daily use.

We are now expanding the engineering team with two R&D Engineers.

Your role

As an R&D Engineer you will work on national and international research and development projects from the first idea through to implementation, at a high international technical level. Specifically, you will:

•     Drive the development and maturation of new machining technologies in our R&D centre

•     Play a central role in process and production optimisation for industrial customers

•     Work closely with cross-functional teams and industry partners

•     Contribute to technologies that support the green transition

•     Share what you find - with engineers, production managers and machine operators alike

Who we are looking for

We are filling two positions and they do not have to be identical profiles.

Essential

•     A degree in mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering or equivalent

•     Real understanding of machining - the process itself, not just the theory around it

•     The ability to explain a technical result clearly to very different audiences, from design engineers to machine operators

•     Fluent English, written and spoken. Danish is not a requirement

Advantageous

•     Specialisation in materials engineering

•     Hands-on experience with material processing and machining techniques

•     Strong analytical skills and experience with trial design, measurement or data analysis

•     Strong IT skills and familiarity with current engineering tools and methods

Ambitious recent graduates are encouraged to apply. If you are early in your career we do not expect the experience - we expect curiosity and a willingness to get your hands dirty.

Eligibility. You must already be entitled to work in Denmark. We are not set up to handle work and residence permit applications, so we can only consider applicants who are citizens of the EU, EEA or Switzerland, or who already hold a valid Danish work permit.

What we offer

•     A high-technology research centre in strong growth, where you are invited to contribute both professionally and personally

•     Direct contact with our members and customers, and time spent inside companies most engineers never see from the inside

•     An innovative, supportive environment alongside highly skilled colleagues who share your interest in engineering

•     Work with technologies that drive the green agenda forward

Living in Herning

Interested in joining an international community in Denmark? Herning has a diverse expat network, and we will welcome you into it.

About DAMRC

DAMRC – Danish Advanced Manufacturing Research Center – is a leader in metal processing and is internationally recognised for ground-breaking innovation.

Our mission is to help Danish companies succeed through innovation and the use of the latest technology. We work in close collaboration with our members, which include several leading companies in metal processing and the machinery industry.

Since 2010 we have completed more than 400 industry projects.

We are a team of around 30 based at Industrivej Syd 17A, 7400 Herning, Denmark.

How to apply

We review applications as they arrive and will close the posting once we have found the right people, so there is no deadline — send yours when you are ready.

Send your application and CV to work@damrc.com with “R&D Engineer” in the subject line.

To hear more before applying, contact Rory Shaw (+45 2253 312/ros@damrc.com) or Sebastián Assain (+45 2222 5594/sea@damrc.com)

Job titleSenior Sourcing SpecialistJob description:
At BeGreen, we develop and operate renewable energy projects built to last across generations. 

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Sourcing Specialist with a strong background in renewables to lead sourcing activities and commercial contracting across solar, hybrid, and energy storage projects based in Denmark, with exposure to international suppliers and projects. 

This position is ideal for someone who understands the unique sourcing and commercial challenges of renewable energy, whether in solar, BESS, or hybrid technologies—and who knows that the right supplier relationships and contracts are what make or break a project. Broader experience in energy infrastructure, construction, or adjacent industries is equally welcome, and will add valuable perspective to our team. 

About the role 

You will take ownership of sourcing strategies, supplier engagement, and contract execution across the full renewable energy project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Sustainability, Cyber Security, HSE, and Legal, you will ensure that commercial decisions drive project performance and long-term value. 

Your hands-on knowledge of the renewables market—its key suppliers, technology trends, cost drivers, and contractual complexities—will be a distinct advantage in this role. Whether you're navigating a large EPC tender for a solar park, structuring a BESS supply agreement, or evaluating a new contractor in an emerging market, your sector insight will be central to how you work. 

Beyond large and complex tenders, you will also support pragmatic sourcing for lower-value purchases, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and speed without compromising quality or governance. 

Key responsibilities 

• Lead end-to-end competitive tenders for major renewable energy packages, including planning, evaluation, negotiation, and contract award 
• Develop and execute sourcing strategies specifically tailored to solar parks, hybrid plants, and battery energy storage systems 
• Leverage renewables market knowledge to drive supplier assessments, benchmark pricing, and identify strategic sourcing opportunities 
• Lead commercial negotiations with energy suppliers and contractors, with a strong focus on risk management and contract robustness 
• Manage both complex, high-value sourcing processes and agile lower-value purchasing activities (RFQs, call-offs, POs) 
• Prepare decision-making materials, including total cost of ownership analyses with a clear understanding of energy project cost structures 
• Support early contract management, including supplier onboarding, performance tracking, and risk assessments 
• Contribute market intelligence on renewable energy supply chains to strengthen category strategies and long-term supplier partnerships 
What you bring 

We are looking for someone with a solid commercial background, and we particularly value: 

• Direct sourcing or commercial experience in solar, BESS, hybrid energy, wind or other renewable technologies 
• Familiarity with key renewable energy suppliers, EPC contractors, and technology providers 
• Understanding of the commercial and technical dynamics specific to utility-scale renewable projects 
 Broader energy & infrastructure experience (also highly valued): 

• Experience in conventional energy, oil & gas, transmission, or large-scale infrastructure procurement 
• Background in complex project environments with multi-stakeholder commercial interfaces 
• Exposure to long-term contracts, framework agreements, and supplier performance management 
In addition, you bring: 

• Confidence in leading negotiations and managing commercial interfaces
• A structured, proactive, and ownership-driven approach to work
• Strong stakeholder management and clear communication skills
• Knowledge of EU procurement regulations (Utilities Directive) or the motivation to build it
• Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish or Swedish is a plus
• Relocation packages are not available for this role and a valid Danish work- and residence permit is a precondition
The team you will join 

You will join BeGreen's Procurement team, a group of specialists working across category management, sourcing, and contract management. We collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and prioritize integrity in both processes and relationships.  

 

What we offer 

• A key role in shaping sourcing practices at a fast-growing renewable energy company 
• Influence across the full project lifecycle—from early development through construction to operations 
• A collaborative, international work environment with passionate and ambitious colleagues 
• A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning 
• Office based in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.  

About BeGreen 

BeGreen develops, builds, and operates onshore energy facilities – primarily solar, wind, and battery solutions. We are around 60 colleagues from diverse backgrounds. We design our projects to work in practice – technically, commercially, and in interaction with local communities. 

BeGreen is headquartered in Denmark and is part of Equinor, an international energy company. This provides a strong foundation and access to experience and competencies across markets. 

Our values: collaboration, integrity and ambition are applied to our projects, decisions, and the way we work together internally and externally.
